3d_expert.name: pLDDT-aware multi-scale structure expert (Cα-EGNN + chemical sites + conformer residual)

multiconformer_extension.deployment_decision: Use the multi-conformer residual by default for records covered by an audited cache; use the exact zero-residual base-3D fallback for uncovered records.
multiconformer_extension.activation: enabled only when audited conformer manifests and their cache roots are explicitly supplied
multiconformer_extension.subset_reuse: Test2 is an exact unique-sequence subset of Test1 and may reuse the audited Test1 conformer cache through an explicit sequence join
multiconformer_extension.missing_policy: hard zero conformer residual; the frozen base 3D prediction is preserved
multiconformer_extension.selection_note: No checkpoint, fusion weight, calibration parameter, or threshold was fitted on Test1/Test2. Retained as the preferred cache-enabled inference path because Test1 classification and both test-set ranking metrics improved; the slight Brier regression remains explicitly reported.

fusion.selection: training-only group-aware OOF with current 3D-expert OOF; MCC objective (consistent protocol, adopted 2026-08-06)

protocol_audit_note: Adopted the consistent/honest protocol: deployed operating point w=0.72, threshold=0.4702 selected on training OOF with the current 3D-expert OOF (MCC objective). Superseded the previous 0.62/0.4977 selected on the mixed (previous-generation fused) OOF. See runs/lora_mamba_full/protocol_audit.json.
